statusDetail: Requested URL redirects to https://www.xnxx.com/. Complete atomic audit across 58 checks and five representative paths.

page.notes: Adult media site. Entry requires an age gate and then cookie choice. Requested xnxx2.com redirects to xnxx.com.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots and computed color-scheme.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The normal and dark-condition captures are byte-identical, computed color-scheme is normal, and no preference-driven theme is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected animation CSS and probed animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent UI defines a 200 ms scale pulse but the captured CSS contains no reduced-motion override; the reduced-motion probe only showed that no animation happened to be active at sampling time.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared prefers-contrast screenshot and Lighthouse contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text and controls remained visible under the contrast condition and Lighthouse reported no color-contrast failures.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS/DOM for authored View Transition usage across MPA routes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No authored view-transition-name or transition rule was found; navigation between listing, search, account, and detail templates is an abrupt full-document swap.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and recorded scrolling under reduced motion.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animation or main-thread scrollytelling effect was present, so the page avoids a scroll-event animation anti-pattern.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed mobile scrolling and controls for gesture interception.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited templates use native document scrolling and ordinary controls; no custom pointermove/swipe implementation fought platform gestures.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed long mobile listing and CSS for scroll-state behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile header remains static and no scroll progress, shrinking-header, or scroll-state query behavior was found on a long results page.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected navigation/menu CSS and DOM for anchor positioning primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menus and the full-screen disclaimer use custom positioned elements; no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed navigation transitions and long-list orientation cues.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Route and menu changes provide no directional transition, progress marker, or post-navigation attention cue beyond an abrupt page replacement.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-load desktop and mobile screenshots and dismissal choices.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first-load interruption is an age/safety gate appropriate to an adult site, followed by cookie controls that offer rejection; underlying thumbnails are blurred until entry.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay DOM and semantics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The full-viewport age and cookie flows are custom div overlays with no dialog element or role=dialog, despite blocking the entire page.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop first viewport and chrome-to-content proportion.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A dense top bar plus a persistent category rail occupy substantial space and present many competing links before the primary content.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured four templates at 360x800.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, search, and detail had no overflow, but the account template reported an 8 px horizontal overflow and an inner width of 368 px in a 360 px viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSSOM for container queries and compared reused layouts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules; reusable listing/header components rely on global viewport behavior only.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused a control, measured visible targets, and reviewed mobile UI.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus is visible, but the results probe found 69 visible interactive elements below 24 px in one dimension, creating undersized touch targets.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewports and headings on home, search, detail, and account.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Page titles, listing headings, search affordance, content tiles, and account headings clearly communicate each template purpose and next action.

checkOutcomes.method: Followed age entry to cookie rejection, then inspected search-result links and a content detail route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The age gate advances to cookie controls, rejection is available, search results expose direct detail links, and the selected detail route loads successfully.

checkOutcomes.method: Loaded an empty search and a nonexistent route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty search explicitly says no match; the 404 page states the problem and provides a home-page recovery link.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse, trace, and layout observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 8.24 s on home and 6.49 s on search, outside the good range, although CLS and TBT were low.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured CLS on home, search, and detail mobile loads.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Observed CLS was 0 on home, 0.0034 on search, and 0.00014 on detail, all well within the good range.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured three traces and layout long-task observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and search traces had no long tasks; detail had one 53.5 ms task and only 3.5 ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HARs, confirmed parser-inserted scripts in live DOM, and ran Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated about 2.9 s render-blocking savings; the DOM confirms a head script without async/defer and multiple parser-inserted scripts, while cache-lifetime savings reached 5,051 KiB on home.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse code diagnostics and inspected HAR weights.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home Lighthouse estimated 386 KiB unused JavaScript and 123 KiB unused CSS; search loaded a 394 KB main script plus legacy jQuery.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and inspected images/forms.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed buttons and links; search had 39 of 41 images without alt text and the search input had no label or aria-label.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse contrast audits and reviewed screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no color-contrast failures on home or search, and essential text remained visible in captured states.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected landmarks/headings and ran focus and Lighthouse probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home page has no h1, main, or nav landmark; the detail page begins at h3. Focus is visible, but semantic structure is incomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop/mobile screenshots and computed styles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dense navigation and metadata are rendered at roughly 12 px with tightly packed lines, reducing reading comfort and scanability.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse viewport audit, mobile layouts, target measurement, and media-track inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse flagged restrictive viewport scaling and the custom probe found 69 undersized targets. The detail video does provide subtitle tracks, but zoom/reflow and target sizing still fail.

checkOutcomes.method: Read Lighthouse console-error audits on home and search.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both Lighthouse runs recorded no browser console errors.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked doctype/charset and ran image audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but every one of 41 search images and 44 detail images lacked explicit width/height; many were oversized.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed Lighthouse best-practices and runtime behavior for prompts/errors.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Best-practices scored 0.96, no console errors or load-time permission prompts were observed, and no paste-blocking behavior surfaced in audited forms.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected metadata across representative templates and raw HTML.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, search, detail, and account have descriptive titles; public content templates include meta descriptions that survive in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchors/viewport and ran Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search contains 23 anchors with missing or hash-only destinations and Lighthouse found non-descriptive link text; account also has 8 px mobile overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical/robots metadata and fetched robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Robots and sitemap are valid, but no rel=canonical was present on the audited home, search, or detail templates, despite duplicate-capable URL patterns.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected Open Graph and JSON-LD on the rich detail entity.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The detail page exposes matching VideoObject JSON-LD plus Open Graph title, URL, duration, and image metadata.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers and cookies primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS and CSP are present, but HSTS and nosniff are missing, CSP allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, and the session cookie uses SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran trackers, HAR, secrets, and cookies primitives before consent.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No known tracker domain or exposed secret was found; observed third-party origins were site CDN infrastructure and only one first-party cookie was set.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected account forms/source for passkeys and load-time permission behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load, but the account flow is password-only with no WebAuthn or passkey capability.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected security response headers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Clickjacking protection exists, but HSTS, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are missing; Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade and CSP permits unsafe execution.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw server HTML with rendered DOM and crawler screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search retains 84% raw-content coverage, but home falls to 29% and detail to 40%; important listing/detail content is substantially reduced without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed responsive overlays, mobile layouts, and runtime traces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The disclaimer constrains itself to the viewport and scrolls when needed; no cut-off overlay or runtime exception was observed on audited templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected manifest/service-worker state and site purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A manifest is linked but no active service worker exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline playback and account actions are intrinsically network-dependent for this streaming site; an installable offline app was not treated as a core requirement.

checkOutcomes.method: Loaded a nonexistent route and an empty result set.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 404 explains the failure and links home; empty search clearly reports zero matches instead of a blank or infinite spinner.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected html language/direction and CSS physical properties.
checkOutcomes.evidence: lang=en is present, but dir is absent and the stylesheet probe found physical left/right declarations rather than a consistently logical-property layout.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative rendered content and forms for locale-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited public and account templates did not present dates, currencies, or locale-formatted numeric inputs.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive data was present in the representative paths, so Intl formatting could not meaningfully apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative flows for time-zone-sensitive scheduling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No event, schedule, recurring interval, or user-entered time appeared.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited browsing, playback, and account flows contain no time-zone-sensitive task.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected age/cookie flow copy, hierarchy, and CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After age entry, “Accept all cookies” is a large primary button while “Reject all cookies” is styled as a borderless underlined text action, creating asymmetric consent pressure.

checkOutcomes.method: Submitted the sign-in form empty and inspected validity/accessibility state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Native required-field messages appear only one field at a time, with no aria-invalid state or alert summary for assistive technology.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected autocomplete tokens on account and search inputs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Email/login and current-password fields have empty autocomplete values; signup username/profile/password fields also omit appropriate tokens.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected account authentication and recovery forms.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Account sign-in is password-only with no phishing-resistant passkey option; password-manager hints are also incomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran images primitive on listing and detail templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search uses 41 legacy-format images with no srcset, 29 oversized; detail has 43 legacy images and 14 oversized, despite one AVIF poster.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured detail HAR and inspected video state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The paused detail player fetched about 3.41 MB of HLS segments during the short capture, before user-initiated playback.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared HAR byte budgets across templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Detail transferred 5.38 MB in 80 requests, including 3.41 MB of media plus 710 KB script; home Lighthouse also reported 5.64 MB total load and large cache-lifetime waste.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM/runtime for WebMCP or agent tool registration and judged emerging applicability.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No WebMCP or structured agent tool was exposed.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media-browsing surface exposes no transactional or productivity capability that needs agent execution; emerging agent tools are an opportunity, not a baseline failure.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected runtime/source for site-authored built-in AI use and judged applicability.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Browser APIs may exist, but the site does not use on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, generation, translation, or inference task in the audited core flow would clearly benefit from site-authored on-device AI.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap summaries and runtime metrics before/after ten full-list scroll cycles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Snapshot self size increased only 29,071 bytes (18,867,779 to 18,896,850) and runtime used heap rose about 131 KB after ten cycles.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed heap totals and DOM/runtime metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing used about 8.15 MB JS heap with 1,942 DOM elements and an 18.9 MB snapshot self-size footprint, proportionate to a 41-image result page.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap node totals, DOM count, and inline-listener element count across repeated interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap nodes rose only 129, DOM nodes stayed at 1,942, and elements with inline listeners stayed at 7 after ten cycles; no accumulation signal appeared.

principleOutcomes.reason: This public media-browsing surface exposes no transactional or productivity capability that needs agent execution; emerging agent tools are an opportunity, not a baseline failure. No summarisation, generation, translation, or inference task in the audited core flow would clearly benefit from site-authored on-device AI.

paths.description: Redirected landing/listing template, age gate, cookie choice, global navigation, and first-load behavior.
Representative search/listing template and repeated long-list scroll interaction.
Representative media detail/playback template, structured metadata, subtitles, and media delivery.
Account sign-up, sign-in, password recovery, autofill, authentication, and invalid-submit behavior.

findings.evidence: The normal and dark-condition captures are byte-identical, computed color-scheme is normal, and no preference-driven theme is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add preference-driven color-scheme theming rather than a fixed palette.

findings.evidence: The consent UI defines a 200 ms scale pulse but the captured CSS contains no reduced-motion override; the reduced-motion probe only showed that no animation happened to be active at sampling time.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap pulse and other non-essential transitions in a no-preference query and disable them under reduce.

findings.evidence: No authored view-transition-name or transition rule was found; navigation between listing, search, account, and detail templates is an abrupt full-document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive cross-document View Transitions for same-origin template navigation.

findings.summary: scroll state aware chrome needs improvement.
findings.evidence: The mobile header remains static and no scroll progress, shrinking-header, or scroll-state query behavior was found on a long results page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a scroll-state-aware compact header or progress affordance on long result pages.

findings.evidence: Menus and the full-screen disclaimer use custom positioned elements; no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use anchored positioning with fallback placement for menus and transient overlays.

findings.evidence: Route and menu changes provide no directional transition, progress marker, or post-navigation attention cue beyond an abrupt page replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add directional/transition cues that preserve orientation across list and detail navigation.

findings.evidence: The full-viewport age and cookie flows are custom div overlays with no dialog element or role=dialog, despite blocking the entire page.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement blocking consent as a semantic dialog with focus trapping, naming, and declarative dismissal.

findings.evidence: A dense top bar plus a persistent category rail occupy substantial space and present many competing links before the primary content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent category chrome and prioritize the content grid and search task.

findings.summary: responsive no horizontal scroll needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Home, search, and detail had no overflow, but the account template reported an 8 px horizontal overflow and an inner width of 368 px in a 360 px viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the account template’s fixed-width overflow and verify true 360 px reflow.

findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules; reusable listing/header components rely on global viewport behavior only.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reused header, card, and account components.

findings.evidence: Focus is visible, but the results probe found 69 visible interactive elements below 24 px in one dimension, creating undersized touch targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive targets to at least 24 by 24 CSS px, preferably 44 px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: good core web vitals needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 8.24 s on home and 6.49 s on search, outside the good range, although CLS and TBT were low.
findings.suggestedFix: Improve LCP discovery and delivery so representative templates reach the good range.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated about 2.9 s render-blocking savings; the DOM confirms a head script without async/defer and multiple parser-inserted scripts, while cache-lifetime savings reached 5,051 KiB on home.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove parser-blocking scripts, shorten critical chains, and set effective cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: trim unused and duplicate code needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Home Lighthouse estimated 386 KiB unused JavaScript and 123 KiB unused CSS; search loaded a 394 KB main script plus legacy jQuery.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and conditionally load the large legacy bundle and remove unused CSS/duplicate jQuery.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed buttons and links; search had 39 of 41 images without alt text and the search input had no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control and linked image an accessible name; label search fields and meaningful thumbnails.

findings.evidence: The home page has no h1, main, or nav landmark; the detail page begins at h3. Focus is visible, but semantic structure is incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav landmarks and a logical h1-to-h3 heading hierarchy on every template.

findings.evidence: Dense navigation and metadata are rendered at roughly 12 px with tightly packed lines, reducing reading comfort and scanability.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase small navigation/metadata text and spacing to improve scanability.

findings.summary: zoom reflow targets and media needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flagged restrictive viewport scaling and the custom probe found 69 undersized targets. The detail video does provide subtitle tracks, but zoom/reflow and target sizing still fail.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, remove reflow overflow, and enlarge undersized touch targets while retaining captions.

findings.summary: sound document and assets needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but every one of 41 search images and 44 detail images lacked explicit width/height; many were oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions/aspect ratios and correct responsive sizing to images.

findings.summary: crawlable and mobile friendly needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Search contains 23 anchors with missing or hash-only destinations and Lighthouse found non-descriptive link text; account also has 8 px mobile overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace hash-only anchors with real destinations or buttons and fix account mobile overflow.

findings.summary: canonical and indexing signals needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Robots and sitemap are valid, but no rel=canonical was present on the audited home, search, or detail templates, despite duplicate-capable URL patterns.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit stable canonical links for home, search, and detail templates.

findings.summary: secure transport and headers needs improvement.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and CSP are present, but HSTS and nosniff are missing, CSP allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, and the session cookie uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and nosniff, tighten CSP, and avoid SameSite=None unless cross-site cookie use is required.

findings.summary: in context permissions and modern auth needs improvement.
findings.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load, but the account flow is password-only with no WebAuthn or passkey capability.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in alongside password fallback.

findings.evidence: Clickjacking protection exists, but HSTS, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are missing; Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade and CSP permits unsafe execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Permissions-Policy, strict referrer policy, HSTS, nosniff, and a nonce/hash-based CSP.

findings.evidence: Search retains 84% raw-content coverage, but home falls to 29% and detail to 40%; important listing/detail content is substantially reduced without JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render essential home and detail content so non-JS users/crawlers receive equivalent core information.

findings.summary: lang dir and logical properties needs improvement.
findings.evidence: lang=en is present, but dir is absent and the stylesheet probe found physical left/right declarations rather than a consistently logical-property layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit direction and migrate layout CSS to logical inline/block properties.

findings.evidence: After age entry, “Accept all cookies” is a large primary button while “Reject all cookies” is styled as a borderless underlined text action, creating asymmetric consent pressure.
findings.suggestedFix: Give Accept and Reject equal visual weight and keep consent choices explicit and reversible.

findings.evidence: Native required-field messages appear only one field at a time, with no aria-invalid state or alert summary for assistive technology.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an accessible error summary and synchronize aria-invalid only after interaction.

findings.evidence: Email/login and current-password fields have empty autocomplete values; signup username/profile/password fields also omit appropriate tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Add username/current-password/new-password and related autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: safe commercial and account flows needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Account sign-in is password-only with no phishing-resistant passkey option; password-manager hints are also incomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey authentication and complete password-manager semantics across account flows.

findings.evidence: Search uses 41 legacy-format images with no srcset, 29 oversized; detail has 43 legacy images and 14 oversized, despite one AVIF poster.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP thumbnails with srcset, sizes, lazy loading, and intrinsic dimensions.

findings.evidence: The paused detail player fetched about 3.41 MB of HLS segments during the short capture, before user-initiated playback.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch HLS segments until the user initiates playback; defer background media work.

findings.summary: third party and media budget needs improvement.
findings.evidence: Detail transferred 5.38 MB in 80 requests, including 3.41 MB of media plus 710 KB script; home Lighthouse also reported 5.64 MB total load and large cache-lifetime waste.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a proportional media/script budget and defer playback/media requests until intent.

taskList.title: Fix accessibility semantics, reflow, and target sizing
Stop eager media transfer and optimize responsive imagery
Improve LCP and critical resource delivery
Harden transport and browser security policies
Modernize account trust, autofill, validation, and authentication
Improve progressive enhancement and indexing signals
Respect user preferences and modern navigation behavior
Reduce chrome and adopt component-responsive layout
Make cookie consent choices visually equal
Add intrinsic image dimensions and asset hygiene

summary.notCovered: Authenticated member-only state, upload completion, paid GOLD checkout, external live-cam/dating destinations, and exhaustive locale variants were not covered because they require credentials/payment or leave the audited origin.
